node.label: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with generalized onset
node.definition: A bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with generalized onset is a type of bilateral tonic-clonic seizure characterized by generalized onset; these seizures rapidly engage networks in both hemispheres at the start of the seizure.
